name: GNX Harness Map (no capture)
_about: Map mod for the no-capture scenarios: like harness_map, but its map is harness_nocap and map_info.no_capture covers stage 0 (all encounter levels). Not for players.
_map_start_note: Distinctive values (none equal a fresh game's defaults) so scenarios can tell map_start was applied.
_no_capture_note: The last no_capture entry is deliberately wrong (stage 7): a mod error, left out; the others still apply.
